# Etsy

> Etsy is a global marketplace platform providing API access for developers and comprehensive buyer protection policies.

Etsy offers both a developer portal with Open API v3 documentation for building integrations, and detailed information on purchase protection, refund policies, and dispute resolution for buyers. The platform emphasizes marketplace tools and shopping safety across its ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Etsy API
- Open API v3
- Developer Portal
- API Documentation
- Getting Started
- Marketplace Tools
- Purchase Protection
- Buyer Protection
- Buyer Guarantee
- Refund Policy
- Dispute Resolution
- Shopping Safety
- Case Process
- Community

## API & Developer Resources

- [Developer Portal home](https://www.etsy.com/developers): Etsy API developer portal with Open API v3 documentation and tools

## Buyer Protection & Policies

- [Etsy Purchase Protection | Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/etsy-purchase-protection): Etsy Purchase Protection policy and buyer guarantee information
